# MediaPipe Tasks Vision 0.10.14, vendored

Served from the site itself so gallery mode needs no CDN (jsDelivr, Google
Storage). Source: `@mediapipe/tasks-vision@0.10.14` on npm and the official
models from `storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models` (hand_landmarker float16/1,
blaze_face_short_range float16/1). Apache License 2.0, © Google LLC.
The source map comment was removed from `vision_bundle.mjs`; nothing else changed.
